MERGE INTO REP_FEE_TRD RIA USING ( SELECT #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PROD_ID, #{payDate,jdbcType=DATE} PAY_DATE, #{feeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} FEE_TYPE, #{paidFee,jdbcType=DECIMAL} PAID_FEE, #{accrual,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ACCRUAL, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL ) TEMP
ON(RIA.PROD_ID = TEMP.PROD_ID and RIA.PAY_DATE = TEMP.PAY_DATE and RIA.FEE_TYPE = TEMP.FEE_TYPE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET RIA.PAID_FEE = TEMP.PAID_FEE, RIA.ACCRUAL = TEMP.ACCRUAL, RIA.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, RIA.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, RIA.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, RIA.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, RIA.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, RIA.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PROD_ID,PAY_DATE,FEE_TYPE, PAID_FEE,ACCRUAL,STATUS, CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT, UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME) VALUES(TEMP.PROD_ID,TEMP.PAY_DATE,TEMP.FEE_TYPE, TEMP.PAID_FEE,TEMP.ACCRUAL,TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.CREATE_USER,TEMP.CREATE_TIME,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.UPDATE_USER,TEMP.UPDATE_TIME)
